IBM is hiring an Application Developer to design, implement, and maintain IT service management solutions. The role supports efficient IT services and business operations by analyzing application functions and troubleshooting ITSM issues.

Design, implement, and maintain IT service management solutions, such as Remedy, ServiceNow, or IBM Control Desk, to meet business needs and ensure seamless IT operations
Analyze and comprehend the business functions of IT service management applications to provide effective solutions and support
Utilize IT service management solutions to efficiently manage IT services, ensuring minimal disruptions to business operations
Leverage technical expertise to troubleshoot and resolve issues related to IT service management solutions, ensuring prompt resolution and minimal downtime

Experience with frameworks for deep learning (e.g. PyTorch, Tensorflow, Jax, Ray, etc.), AI accelerators (e.g. TPUs, GPUs), model architectures (e.g. encoders, decoders, transformers), and using machine learning APIs
Experience reading code in a general purpose coding language (e.g., Java, C, C++, Python, Shell, Go or JavaScript, etc.) or in system design
